title: solutions-pro-services-weekly-sync-notes-2026-06-23
content:
Weekly sync: Solutions Engineering + Professional Services — 2026-06-23
Facilitator: Aisha Patel
Note: informal notes, capture action items + blockers.

Attendees:
- Aisha Patel (owner)
- Ben Rodriguez
- Chen Li
- Dana Morales
- Evan Brooks
- Guest: Jorge (Customer Success, brief for RetailOne)

Agenda:
1) Quick customer status roll (Acme, MediHealth, Finly, RetailOne)
2) Open blockers & escalations (SRE / infra)
3) Upcoming rollouts / canaries / cutovers
4) Action items and owners

Quick updates (round-robin):
- AcmeCorp (pilot) — Ben
  - Current environment: staging cluster with dedicated pool (v2.3 runtime).
  - Status: end-to-end validated for standard chat flows; encountering 95th p95 latency spikes under load test (spiky sequence lengths).
  - Root cause hypothesis: kernel scheduling + batch sizing policy; observed large KV cache thrash when sequence lengths > 1024.
  - Temporary mitigation: set batch_size_max=8 and enable prefix_kv_cache for chat endpoints. Doing canary tomorrow AM.
  - Linked: PROJ-3421 (latency regression), runbook draft at Confluence.

- MediHealth (private deployment / compliance onboarding) — Chen
  - Status: Private control plane deployed to customer VPC; HSM/KMS integration pending.
  - Blocker: KMS key rotation policy mismatch (customer uses periodic rotation, our deployment requires fixed alias mapping). Security team opened a policy exception request.
  - Action: Chen to open HSM integration design doc PR and schedule call with customer SecOps 2026-06-25.
  - Compliance: started SOC-like checklist; we need to provide audit log retention config (SRE input).

- Finly (embeddings + reranking pilot) — Dana
  - Status: embeddings staging pipeline hooked; quality issue: mismatch between on-host quantized model outputs and hosted reference embeddings (drift ~ 0.08 cosine on sample set).
  - Investigation: likely quantization profile differences + tokenization edge-case for ticker symbols.
  - Next: run A/B with full-precision model for 24h; PR in repo for tokenizer normalization incoming (GH PR 1786).
  - Customer ask: confirm deterministic outputs for daily reindex job; raising risk if drift persists.

- RetailOne (Dedicated trial/ SLO discussion) — Evan / Jorge
  - Status: Dedicated pool provisioned in us-west; throughput tests pass for baseline traffic.
  - Concern: cost smoothing — customer wants predictable per-request billing window for spike-days. Need to propose burst policy + reserve commit.
  - Action: Evan to draft commit proposal and pricing scenarios by 2026-06-29; sync with Sales.

Open blockers / escalations:
- VPN / network tunnel instability for MediHealth private deploy — packet drops intermittently during large KV syncs. SRE ticket created (PROJ-3498).
- Model variant fallback behavior: during Acme load test we saw fallback to smaller model triggered frequently; need threshold tuning in smart-router policy.
- Observability gap: token-level cost attribution missing for some helper routes (console + routing). Product asked for sample query traces for next week.

Decisions made in meeting:
- For Acme latency issue, we will canary batch_size_max=8 + enable prefix_kv_cache; roll back if p95 not improved by 12pm (tomorrow).
- For Finly embeddings drift, hold on quantized rollout until A/B confirms <0.02 drift; no customer-facing cutover until confirmed.

Action items (owner — due):
- Ben: Run Acme canary and collect p50/p95/p99; share dashboard link and summary (due 2026-06-24).
- Chen: Draft HSM/KMS integration doc + schedule SecOps call with MediHealth (due 2026-06-25).
- Dana: Deploy FP A/B run for Finly and post results to Slack channel #finly-embeddings (due 2026-06-24).
- Evan: Prepare Dedicated commit + burst pricing scenarios and sync with Sales (due 2026-06-29).
- Aisha: Coordinate SRE for VPN packet drops; escalate to infra if not resolved by EOD 2026-06-25 (due 2026-06-25).
- All: Add missing trace_ids for token-level cost attribution to sample event (collect by 2026-06-26).

Notes / scratchpad:
- Quick TODO: update runbook step for canary rollback thresholds (confusing right now).
- Remember to link dashboards: perf-test/acme-2026-06-23; will add once Ben posts.
- Meeting with Product next Wed to discuss new routing policy UI; bring examples from Acme test.

Risks / concerns:
- If KV cache thrash not fixed, per-token cost could spike 15–25% for chat workloads — impacts unit economics for pilot customers.
- KMS integration delays could push MediHealth to ask for extended SOC docs and stall go-live by >2 weeks.

Next meeting: 2026-06-30 10:30am PT

Attachments / references:
- Confluence: Acme Pilot Runbook (link above)
- Jira: PROJ-3421 (Acme latency), PROJ-3498 (MediHealth network)
- GH: runtime PR 1786 (tokenizer fix)

End of notes.
